# Support

- **Bugs:** open an issue with the [Bug report](https://github.com/halitsever/repo_name/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) template.
- **Feature ideas:** open an issue with the [Feature request](https://github.com/halitsever/repo_name/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) template.
- **Questions:** open a [blank issue](https://github.com/halitsever/repo_name/issues/new) and describe what you're trying to do.
- **Security problems:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Please don't post them publicly.
